name: Abe Mariya
source: One of [url=/c53875]Bango's[/url] childhood friends and also [url=/c54377]Reiji's[/url] little sister. When she started high school, she and her brother moved back to Mina-Asakusa. Mariya is a freshman at Kototoi Academy, but because of her weak and fragile body coupled with childish and innocent personality, she looks much younger than she is. Because of her personality, she is easily teased by Bango. She is also very clumsy, sensitive, and loves shoujo manga and fairy tales. Her ability, "Sweet Sweat", makes her release a very sweet fragrance, which then raises one's sense of wanting to protect her.
